appDesc.message: Make any tab louder (up to 6x) or quieter, keeping fullscreen when possible. Per-tab memory, built-in limiter, no data collected.
appDesc.description: Store / extension-manager description. HARD LIMIT: 132 characters.

resetBtn.description: Tiny header button that snaps the level back to 1× (off). Keep it very short.

subCurrentTab.description: Subtitle placeholder shown before the tab's site is known.

subThisTab.description: Appended after the site's hostname, e.g. “youtube.com · this tab”.

modeChecking.description: Status pill while the extension probes the page.

scaleOff.description: Center label of the slider scale: 1× = no change (off). Keep “1×”.

limiterHint.description: One-line hint under the Limiter label.

fsLabel.description: Per-tab toggle: keep native fullscreen instead of boosting via capture. This name is quoted verbatim inside pausedMsgConflict / pausedMsgPref / captureMsgConflict - keep them identical.

fsHint.message: Skip capture - keep fullscreen, no boost
fsHint.description: One-line hint under the Prefer-fullscreen label.

blockedText.message: This page can't be boosted. Browser pages, the Web Store, and other extensions are off-limits to audio capture. Open a normal site (YouTube, etc.) and try again.
blockedText.description: Shown on pages the extension cannot work on (chrome:// pages, the Web Store).

modeElement.description: Green status pill: adjusting the page's own media element; native fullscreen keeps working. Keep short - the popup is only 268px wide.

modeElementTitle.message: Adjusting the page's own media element in-page - fullscreen stays available.

modePaused.description: Status pill when the user chose fullscreen over boosting. Keep short; keep the “ · ” separator.

modePausedTitleConflict.message: Another app is using this tab's audio. Boost is paused so native fullscreen keeps working.
modePausedTitleConflict.description: Tooltip of the paused pill when another app controls the tab's audio.

modePausedTitlePref.message: “Prefer fullscreen” is on for this tab, so the volume level isn't applied via capture.
modePausedTitlePref.description: Tooltip of the paused pill when the user's own toggle causes the pause. Quotes the fsLabel name.

pausedMsgConflict.message: Another app is already using this tab's audio. Boost is paused so fullscreen keeps working - turn off “Prefer fullscreen” to boost via capture instead (fullscreen off).
pausedMsgConflict.description: Explanation box in the paused+conflict state. Quotes the fsLabel name.

pausedMsgPref.message: “Prefer fullscreen” is on for this tab, so the level isn't applied via capture. Turn it off to adjust the volume on this page (fullscreen is unavailable while capturing).
pausedMsgPref.description: Explanation box in the paused state without a conflict. Quotes the fsLabel name.

modeCapture.description: Amber status pill: boosting via tab capture (fullscreen disabled while boosted). Keep short.

modeCaptureConflict.description: Capture pill when another app also uses the tab's audio. Keep short; keep the “ · ” separator.

modeCaptureTitle.message: This source can't be hooked directly (DRM, cross-origin, or no element), so tab capture is used. Fullscreen is disabled while boosted; drop to 1.0× to fullscreen.
modeCaptureTitle.description: Tooltip of the capture pill (normal case).

modeCaptureTitleConflict.message: Another app is using this tab's audio, so it's boosting via capture. Fullscreen is disabled while boosted.
modeCaptureTitleConflict.description: Tooltip of the capture pill on a conflict.

captureMsgConflict.message: Another app is already using this tab's audio, so it's boosting via capture - fullscreen is unavailable. Turn on “Prefer fullscreen” to keep fullscreen instead (no boost).
captureMsgConflict.description: Explanation box in the capture+conflict state. Quotes the fsLabel name.

modeNone.description: Neutral status pill at 1× (off). Keep short.
